metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 1990 · Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
metas.description: Four teenage mutant ninja turtles emerge from the shadows to protect New York City from a gang of criminal ninjas.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.1 · 1991 · Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
metas.description: The Turtles discover their origins while they endeavour to save New York City from the evil Shredder and his Foot Clan.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.8 · 1993 · Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III
metas.description: When journalist April O'Neil discovers an ancient scepter with magical powers, the Turtles must cow-a-bunga their way back to 17th century Japan to rescue her from the evil clutches of Lord Norinaga.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.2 · 2007 · TMNT
metas.description: When the world is threatened by an ancient evil, the Ninja Turtles must reunite and overcome their faults in order to stand against it.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.6 · 2009 · Turtles Forever
metas.description: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles meet their match -- Literally! The modern, gritty Ninja Turtles must team up with their classic cartoon counterparts to stop two Shredders and their plans of multi-dimensional scale.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 5.8 · 2014 · Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
metas.description: When a kingpin threatens New York City, a group of mutated turtle warriors must emerge from the shadows to protect their home.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.3 · 2015 · Half-Shell Heroes: Blast to the Past
metas.description: A TMNT one hour TV special based on the Half Shell Heroes toy-line. The turtles get snapped back into the past and must find their way through the pre-historic dinosaurs and triceratons in order to get back home.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.9 · 2016 · Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
metas.description: The Turtles get into another battle with their enemy the Shredder, who has acquired new allies: the mutant thugs Bebop and Rocksteady and the alien being Krang.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 6.2 · 2022 · Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Movie
metas.description: When a mysterious stranger arrives from the future with a dire warning, Leo is forced to rise and lead his brothers, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey in a fight to save the world from a terrifying alien species.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 7.2 · 2023 · Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
metas.description: The Turtle brothers work to earn the love of New York City while facing down an army of mutants.
